{"response":{"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n\n  // Track restart intervals to calculate binary yield rate.\n  // We use static variables to snapshot statistics at the beginning of the current interval.\n  static uint64_t last_restarts_count = 0;\n  static uint64_t start_binary = 0;\n  static uint64_t start_conflicts = 0;\n\n  const uint64_t current_restarts = solver-\u003estatistics.restarts;\n\n  // Handle solver reset or new instance (safeguard for static variables)\n  if (current_restarts \u003c last_restarts_count) {\n      last_restarts_count = 0;\n      start_binary = 0;\n      start_conflicts = 0;\n  }\n\n  // Detect if a restart occurred since the last call\n  if (current_restarts \u003e last_restarts_count) {\n      last_restarts_count = current_restarts;\n      start_binary = solver-\u003estatistics.clauses_binary;\n      start_conflicts = CONFLICTS;\n  }\n\n  // Step 5: Enforce 'cooldown' override.\n  // We use the solver's existing restart limit to ensure the minimum interval has passed.\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n\n  // Stable mode handling (Reluctant Doubling)\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Focused Mode: Quadratic Binary-Yield Tolerance Algorithm\n\n  // Step 1: Retrieve EMAs\n  const double fast_lbd = AVERAGE (fast_glue);\n  const double slow_lbd = AVERAGE (slow_glue);\n\n  // Step 2: Calculate binary_yield_rate\n  const uint64_t conflicts_since = CONFLICTS - start_conflicts;\n  const uint64_t binary_since = solver-\u003estatistics.clauses_binary - start_binary;\n\n  double binary_yield_rate = 0.0;\n  if (conflicts_since \u003e 0) {\n      binary_yield_rate = (double) binary_since / (double) conflicts_since;\n  }\n\n  // Step 3: Compute dynamic restart threshold factor T\n  // T = 1.05 + (5.0 * rate^2)\n  const double T = 1.05 + (5.0 * binary_yield_rate * binary_yield_rate);\n\n  // Step 4: Evaluate restart condition\n  const double limit = slow_lbd * T;\n\n  kissat_extremely_verbose (solver,\n                            \"QBYT restart: rate=%.4f T=%.4f fast=%.2f slow=%.2f limit=%.2f\",\n                            binary_yield_rate, T, fast_lbd, slow_lbd, limit);\n\n  return (fast_lbd \u003e limit);\n}\n\u003c/code\u003e","thoughtSignature":""}]},"index":0,"finishReason":"STOP"}],"responseId":"k3CKaeCQGPa3_uMPns6c6QE","modelVersion":"gemini-3-pro-preview","usageMetadata":{"promptTokensDetails":[{"tokenCount":6061,"modality":"TEXT"}],"thoughtsTokenCount":13255,"totalTokenCount":20032,"promptTokenCount":6061,"candidatesTokenCount":716}},"model":"models/gemini-3-pro-preview","key":"req-0001"}
